title.en: An agent request without start_cooking in its mandate is refused

goal.en: Core rule 6.5: an agent's request carries an AgentMandate and the executor refuses what is outside it (mandate_scope). Start shakshuka twice with the recipe's real hash: once with a planning-only mandate, once with start_cooking, then stop the accepted run.

note.en: Fetch shakshuka; its id is example-shakshuka and the hub addresses it as cw:cookwala.ai:example-shakshuka.
The request must carry the recipe hash; a wrong one is refused as recipe_hash_mismatch before the mandate is even read.
An agent with scopes plan_meals and search_recipes asks the device to cook: refused, reason mandate_scope. The refusal is a result with HTTP 202, not an error.
The same request under a mandate that includes start_cooking is accepted; the device still runs its own dry run and limits first.
Stop it: a stop is never refused for authorization once the caller can reach the executor (Core rule 6.2).

outcome.en: You have seen the executor enforce the mandate; the MCP server's check_mandate tool does the same check before a request is sent, and irreversible and safety_override always need the principal's confirmation. Next: 098 reads recipe text in two languages.
